title: Negative bribery majority tail identity
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $m$ be a positive integer, and set the first $k$ coordinates of majority on the $(k+m)$-dimensional sign cube to $-1$. Its positive bias equals the average over all $m$-dimensional sign vectors $y$ of the indicator that $\sum_{j=1}^m y_j/\sqrt m>(k-1)/\sqrt m$.
